Dhiman Mishra

Network Engineering Specialist at NTT Data

Career Objective To work in a challenging environment on latest build tools and technologies where I can improve my skill sets and put them to use for development of project and contribute to success of my organization as well as myself.

Expertise : - Routers Cisco 1841,2951,2921,ISR 4K series - Switches Cisco 3750, 3560, 2960, 3850, 6500, Nexus 7K, 9K Series, Nexus 2K, 9K FEXs -

Arista 7280,7506 Series

-Cisco Viptela SDWAN Vmanage -Cisco Wireless Controllers and Access Points

Work Experience:

NTT Data, Noida (November 2022- Currently working) Employment Summary:

Job Role: Network Engineering Specialist Project name: CITI Bank (Datacenter Migration and Implementation)

Domain: BFSI

Key Roles/Responsibilities at NTT Data : -Working as a Migration and implementation Engineer CITI Bank Datacenters in North Americas -Replacing End of Vendor Support production Leaf Switches with the Newer Models (Arista to Arista, Arista to Nexus, Nexus to Nexus along with FEX Replacement) - Handling Projects independently from Preparing the Design Documents along with

Complete Configurations, Cabling Representation with Appropriate SFP/Breakout Modules as per the Approved Standards

Modifying the Network Diagrams in MS Visio -Taking Approvals from the Citi SMEs for the Network Design Document -Creating the changes and Representing the same in Internal Reviews and CITI CAB as well. - Performing the Pre and Post checks during change and Ensure complete Services Restoration with Zero

Downtime for any Server/Application - Independently Implementing the Entire change Remotely along with the Coordination

from Hands and Feet Support.

-Ensuring to Follow the Correct Deployment standards along with the Configurations based on the POD type of the Leaf Switches. - Coordinating and Cascading the Information With Server and Application teams regarding

the change and addressing the Queries raised.

Performing the Pre and Post checks during change and Ensure complete Services

Restoration with Zero Downtime for any Server/Application

Independently Implementing the Entire change Remotely along with the Coordination

from Hands and Feet Support

Coordinating and Cascading the Information With Server and Application teams regarding

the change and addressing the Queries raised.

Ensuring timely Delivery of the Projects and ensuring to close the Jira Record before the

End Date.

-Thorough understanding for the Tools used in CITI environment in order to Implement the Changes smoothly - Decommissioning of the Devices having no Server Connectivity and Ensuring to Free the

Subnets used in the Decommissioned Devices for future Use.

Tech Mahindra, Noida (May 2022- October 2022) Employment Summary:

Job Role: Senior Associate Technical Support Project name: AT&T Tier 2 Network Support

Domain: BPS

Key Roles/Responsibilities at Tech Mahindra : -Worked as Tier 2 Engineer for AT&T majorly US Business Clients -Troubleshooting the issues like Circuit down, Internet down, Degraded Services, slow Internet, Packet Loss, Certain Website/Application Not Reachable - Providing Information to Clients Related to their Services, Total Bandwidth of the Circuit, IP Block information for LAN/WAN side -Engaging different Teams as per the Identified Issue like Circuit/Backbone/MACD -Dispatching and Engaging Engineer to Customer Sites -Coordinating between different teams and providing latest update to the Client on their Ticket -Coordinating with Clients for the Closure of the tickets once the Issue looks Resolved as per the checks.

Wipro Technology, Pune (2019-2022) Employment Summary:

Job Role: Student Computer Applications Project name: Magneti Marelli , Olympus Corporation

Domain: Cloud and Infrastructure Services

Key Roles/Responsibilities at Wipro : -Prepare Daily Health Checkup report for core devices. -Prepare Weekly health status of all devices and taking backup of configuration -Monitoring for the health and alarms of all network devices. -Handling all priority Alerts and Alarms

-Creating and managing Network Device Inventories -Configuration VLANS (Layer2/Layer 3) -Configuration of SNMP

Page 1 of 3

-Troubleshooting routing (WAN links, Neighbor ship stability, routing protocols) and switching issues. - Contacted respective service provider, Local IT engineers for relevant network checks, providing them entire network details. - Dealt with user reported network issues. - Troubleshooting issues like site-down, link flaps, slow response, high utilization, Access

point unknown, switch down and packet drops, Vlan Mapping, Access Port Configurations - Opening TAC/Vendor/ISP Cases on High Priority Incidents -Providing remote access to Cisco Devices through Telnet & SSH.

Responsible for modifying services as per the customer requests. -Keeping sites or devices under maintenance, stopping management traffic temporarily. Providing unused IP/Subnet as per the Requirements -Monitoring and Basic checks on Viptela Sdwan Vmanage and VEdge (OMP, BFD Flaps, TLOC, Tunnel interface Utilizations etc) -Creating Changes and Representing the same on CAB Calls and to other Technical Teams

Tools: ➢Monitoring Tool: Service Now, Jira, Science Logic, Summit

➢Network Management Tool: Solarwinds, Cisco V-Manage, IPAM, Cisco Prime, Splunk,

➢Others: Putty, MS Visio, Pingsweep Utility, Sharepoint, Secure CRT

Technical Skills: ➢ STATIC ROUTING.

➢OSPF ➢BGP ➢Datacenter Technologies (Spine-Leaf Architecture)

➢ OSI Layers

➢ Basic Viptela SDWAN ➢Switching (VTP, STP) ➢SNMP, TACACS Configuration

➢ NAT, PAT, ACL

➢ Ether channels ➢HSRP, VRRP ➢port Security ➢Configuration of DHCP

➢ITIL Processes (Incident/Change/Problem/MIM)

Personal Skills:

➢ Good Analytical & Quantitative skills.

➢ Innovative Approach

➢ Quick Learner and Adaptive to changes ➢ Effective Leadership skills

Educational Qualification: ➢ Bachelor of Computer Applications (2019) with 67%

➢ High School (2014) with CGPA 7.6

➢ Intermediate (2016) with 73%

Hobbies: ➢ Travelling.

➢Listening to music.

➢ Badminton, Table Tennis

Contact Details: ➢ Mobile no: +91-7668818192

➢ Email address: dhiman.mishra123@gmail.com
